title: Build a Python MCP Client to Test Servers From Your Terminal
description: Follow this Python project to build an MCP client that discovers MCP server capabilities and feeds an AI-powered chat with tool calls.
summary: Building an MCP client in Python can be a good option when you’re coding MCP servers and want a quick way to test them. In this step-by-step project, you’ll build a minimal MCP client for the command line.
takeaways: You can use the OpenAI Python SDK to integrate MCP tool responses into an AI-powered chat session.
You’ll also use the Model Context Protocol (MCP) Python SDK .
To learn more about this topic, check out the Python MCP Server: Connect LLMs to Your Data tutorial.
